name: Martin Roach
bio: Martin Roach (born 15 July 1962, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada) is an African-Canadian actor and voice actor. He is best known as Admiral Michael Souther in The Expanse (2015–2018) and Picard in Reacher (2022). In film, he has appeared in Spotlight (2015), The Shape of Water (2017), and Shazam! (2019). In voice acting, he is known as Dr. Claw in the Inspector Gadget reboot (2015–2018) and Pastor Jerome Jeffries in Far Cry 5 (2018).
